item.title: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Akestgenes #767 the Twice-Bor
item.description: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Akestgenes #767 the Twice-Born rose from Asphodel and returned to the Field of Ares.

item.title: The god answered Alkkles #9660 in verse: "Two cities, one field: the one that boasts will
item.description: The god answered Alkkles #9660 in verse: "Two cities, one field: the one that boasts will weep." Nobody agrees what it means. Chrysope #7150 says they know.

item.title: Archlaos #6852 the Twice-Born and Hypsstratos #5737 the Twice-Born fought in the Field of
item.description: Archlaos #6852 the Twice-Born and Hypsstratos #5737 the Twice-Born fought in the Field of Ares. Both limp now; neither will forget.

item.description: Thrasides #6415 buried Akestgenes #767. Two obols for Charon, one for the spade.

item.title: Akestgenes #767 was broken in the archipelago (the stone in their midst (House of Chthoniu
item.description: Akestgenes #767 was broken in the archipelago (the stone in their midst (House of Chthonius)). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.

item.title: Eumachos #8589 answered the city's hunger: 540 obols of grain bought and carried to the hu
item.description: Eumachos #8589 answered the city's hunger: 540 obols of grain bought and carried to the hungry of the Field of Ares. The Boule named them; they paid beyond the minimum.

item.title: Every month, without a word, Ersope #8727 the Avenger sends Ersstratos #6853 a little silv
item.description: Every month, without a word, Ersope #8727 the Avenger sends Ersstratos #6853 a little silver. Everyone in the Field of Ares has noticed, nobody knows why.
